source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_003],

I appreciate the prompt reply. We are preparing to submit a financial model to the government for a possible PPP project. One major requirement is to clearly show and substantiate why availability-style payments are needed for the project to be viable and bankable.

For your assessment, I have attached the Excel template and further project information. Please confirm whether you can help us develop the model. It may contain errors, so we need you to review them and make the model professional, clear, and strong.

value_updates.availability_payment_justification: Clearly show and substantiate why availability-style payments are needed for the project to be viable and bankable.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Regarding timing, we want to proceed as fast as possible. Could we target completion by FRIDAY at the latest? Please therefore begin building the model with the information currently available, and we can update it as further inputs are confirmed.

For the available data:

1)I have attached the feasibility/demand analysis, FleetPod-Demand-Analysis. You may use it as directional support together with the brief's assumptions.

2)The capex values have not been finalized. The total program is presently estimated at 150–180M, so you may use the midpoint of the ranges stated in the brief. The attached business case contains the midpoint set.

3) Firm figures for land values, lease costs, opex, and pricing are not yet available. Use the indicative document ranges and clearly identify the assumptions.

4) No financing terms have been finalized, and there are currently no lender or investor commitments. Please use standard market assumptions drawn from the supplied ranges.

5) Structured site-level information, including traffic counts and land status, is not currently available. We only have a general traffic count by corridor; because site-level details are unavailable, they will need to be modelled.

6) Use CAD and a 2026 base year.
7) The model must clearly establish and justify why availability-style payments are required to make the project viable and bankable. THIS IS THE CORE INFORMATION THE GOVERNMENT WANTS TO SEE, so it needs to be modelled correctly.

Overall, proceed with the brief and attachments as the main reference sources, and clearly annotate each assumption. We will continue refining the model as firmer information becomes available.

Please inform me if any critical issue comes up while you are building it.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: While completing the model, remember that the figures remain projections. At this point, our main objective is to give the government sufficiently robust financial information to clearly support the need for an availability-style payment. The model must plainly show that user fees by themselves cannot make the project viable and bankable.

value_updates.user_funded_case_required_finding: User fees by themselves cannot make the project viable and bankable.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Sure, that’s fine; we can close the contract at this point.

For clarity and to have it on the record, I delivered the first draft on schedule, and it included everything from the original brief. After you said it was difficult to follow, I did not disregard that feedback. Instead, I submitted a second version with substantial revisions that directly addressed it. This included a simplified dashboard, assumptions with clear sources, separate cash flows for both funding scenarios, extra financial statements, and a brief summary presentation to make the review easier. I sent that second deliverable before you asked for this refund. Despite my requests, I received no specific review comments on either the first draft or the second version.

Because both milestones were completed and delivered according to scope, I will not issue a refund. I will take this through Upwork's dispute process to settle the outstanding milestone payment. You may leave whichever review you believe is accurate, and I will do likewise. The delivered work and our message history can speak for themselves.

I’m happy for both sides to conclude this professionally.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the second model version included separate cash flows for both funding scenarios.

routing_warnings.description: The DSCR and equity-IRR thresholds govern numerical availability-payment sizing rather than the funding-scenario comparison.
The reported failure to communicate returns, debt performance, and bankability concerns the decision dashboard rather than the scenario-comparison calculation.
